adsetTakeaway: For 19–25 October, Video/Reels delivered 6 of 9 Meta-reported leads, but Static delivered 3 leads and 2 of 5 reported registrations. Keep both in the mix while the new ads gather more evidence.
creativeNote: The refreshed ads went live around 19–20 October. The Refunding Users repost brought volume and inexpensive visits, while the IRD Letter static also produced leads. Judge the next creative round on registrations and eventual activations, not clicks alone.

findings.title: New creative is live
findings.body: The refreshed Video/Reels and Static ads launched around 19–20 October. In 19–25 October, the Refunding Users repost recorded 4 leads on about NZ$332 spend; the IRD Letter static recorded 2 leads on about NZ$109. Several newer variants have had too little spend to judge yet.

findings.title: Volume improved, but leads did not
findings.body: Compared with 12–18 October, 19–25 October generated 816 landing-page views versus 353, while reported leads moved from 10 to 9. Spend rose from about NZ$824 to NZ$892. More traffic has not yet translated into more leads.

findings.title: Static is contributing to registrations
findings.body: Video/Reels delivered 6 leads and 3 Meta-reported registrations last week; Static delivered 3 leads and 2 registrations. These are separate tracked actions, not verified paying customers, so it is too early to move all the budget to Video/Reels.

findings.title: How a lead is counted
findings.body: Meta's Results count is the Lead event, not a confirmed Lodg signup or paying customer. Cross-device or later registrations may be missed; compare these figures with Lodg's own registration and first-payout records before drawing acquisition-cost conclusions.

nextSteps.title: Check where the extra traffic drops off
nextSteps.body: Review the live ad links and mobile sign-up journey, then compare landing-page views, Lead events and Lodg registrations by date. The new creative is bringing more visitors, but lead volume has not risen with it.

nextSteps.title: Keep both ad sets running while we assess the new ads
nextSteps.body: Give the 19–20 October creative a fair test and review each ad's leads and registrations after another full week. Keep the proven $47+gst static ad and Refunding Users creative in the mix; do not scale a repost solely because its clicks are cheap.

nextSteps.title: Match reported results to paying customers
nextSteps.body: Reconcile Meta Lead and Complete Registration events against Lodg's registrations and first payouts. Use cost per activated customer, not just cost per Lead, to decide which ads and ad sets deserve more spend.

nextSteps.title: Hold the roughly NZ$4,000 monthly pace for now
nextSteps.body: The last reported allocation was NZ$100/day Video/Reels and NZ$33/day Static (NZ$133/day, roughly NZ$3,990 per 30 days). Confirm the live budgets in Ads Manager before changing them. Reallocate within that total only after checking lead quality and registrations; discuss any increase with Lodg after activation costs are known.

budget.label: Last reported allocation: NZ$100 Video/Reels + NZ$33 Static; live setting not verified
